messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D desktop soccer game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- At completion, briefly note assumptions.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-based 3D exhibition match with a night-league stadium, desktop keyboard controls, opposing teams, score/clock HUD, and pause/restart.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added game UI and styling in `index.html`.
- Implemented 3D pitch, stadium, players, ball physics, basic AI, match clock, scoring, and controls in `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.

### Active
- Validate the game in a browser and fix any runtime or visual issues.

### Blocked
- Initial `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium was not installed. Chromium was subsequently installed with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`; browser validation has not yet been retried.

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`.
2. Check browser console/runtime errors and the rendered game; save and inspect a latest screenshot as a small JPEG.
3. Fix any issues and report the completed game and brief assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game HUD, styling, and module entry point.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Three.js is loaded from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- The game controls are WASD/arrow keys to move, Shift to sprint, Space to shoot, E to pass, Esc to pause, and R to restart.
